statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The diagnosis code for atherosclerotic heart disease is I25.10
The diagnosis code for nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency is I34.0
The procedure code billed is CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry)
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The denial reason is that required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the service date
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate intermittent symptoms with potential arrhythmias
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to assess the efficacy of current rate-control management
